persona.archetype: clerk of a wool merchant's counting-room
persona.backstory: He has kept the house's ledger for eleven years and has never had a column that did not add up.
persona.demeanor: Tired, careful, frightened in a way he keeps out of his voice.
persona.motivation: Stop the night entries before the house believes them.
persona.secret: He has woken twice at the desk with ink on his fingers and told nobody.
persona.speech_style: Plain and exact, like a man reading figures aloud. Short sentences.
